implementation.targetScope: React 19 native external-store hook and selector helper, including shim import aliases. React 16–18 fallback implementations excluded.

source: Native subscription entry points re-export React; selector reader and hook wiring are independently written. Upstream test contracts retained as attributed reference evidence, not shipped runtime.

verification.callers: Twelve mounted cases per implementation on Node 24 and Bun include real React Redux 9.2.0; MUI Data Grid, Tiptap, XState and MobX are lockfile evidence only.

verification.performance: Isolated balanced process measurements retain controls and raw samples; no directional performance claim established.
